decisions.why: delegate answer (owner said decide yourself); matches the reference design's J1-J4

decisions.what: Q2 speaker: 4 ohm min, 8 ohm typ
decisions.why: delegate; 10uH filter suits both

decisions.what: Q3 power in: bare wire pads
decisions.why: delegate; like-for-like with the reference design

decisions.what: Q4 no mute/fault LED; fixed pull-ups, always on
decisions.why: delegate; the reference design has none

decisions.what: Q5 supply 12V nom, 10.8-13.2V, caps >=25V
decisions.why: delegate default

decisions.what: Q6 PROVISIONAL (safety, >3A borderline): 3A continuous on 12V input, 3A per speaker output
decisions.why: delegate; TPA3116D2 ~2x15W into 4ohm at 12V -> ~2.8A supply; unattended run, reconfirm at H1

decisions.what: Q7 no reverse-polarity protection
decisions.why: delegate; matches the reference design part count; noted as a deviation risk in COMPARISON

decisions.what: Q8 PCB copper heat-sinking only (PowerPAD thermal vias to bottom pour), grow board if needed and record
decisions.why: owner: thermal first, then size

decisions.what: Q9 no mounting holes
decisions.why: delegate; bare module like the reference design

decisions.what: Q10 qty 5, no unit-cost target, JLC stocked parts
decisions.why: delegate default

decisions.what: Q11 JLC PCBA top side only unless size forces otherwise
decisions.why: delegate default

decisions.what: Q12 line-level in, keep the reference design's 5.6k/100k gain/config
decisions.why: delegate; like-for-like

decisions.what: DEVIATION: amp IC TPA3116D2DAD -> TPA3118D2DAP (same SLOS708 family, same 32-pin HTSSOP pinout, PowerPAD DOWN)
decisions.why: TPA3116D2 exists only as DAD (pad UP, TI SLOS708); its 14 C/W needs a top heatsink, which the reference design's own write-up admits is not modeled. Brief: thermal pad/heat-sinking first, SMD only. At 12 V output is rail-limited so no audio power lost; pad-down lets 2-layer copper + vias sink it (~22-30 C/W).

decisions.what: Q6 revised: +12V input and its GND return sized for 4 A; 3 A per speaker output; inductor Isat >= 4 A
decisions.why: power research: 3.6 A at 10% THD into 4 ohm, 4.0 A at 13.2 V

decisions.what: Sustained full-power 4 ohm sine at 40 C is NOT a requirement (music + 8 ohm full power are); keep the size target
decisions.why: power research: that case needs ~50x50 mm 2 oz or PLIMIT; thermal shutdown is the chip's own protection; FAULTZ->SDZ gives auto-recovery

decisions.what: Prefer 2 oz outer copper if the stackup table offers it for 2L
decisions.why: halves trace widths and improves spreading; 0.65 mm pitch is fine at 2 oz floors

decisions.what: PLIMIT tied to GVDD (no limit); FAULTZ tied to SDZ with 100k pull-up for self-clearing thermal fault; gain 20 dB via 5.6k master
decisions.why: TI 12 V design; refdesign research resolves the reference design's 5.6k/100k as gain leg + pull-ups

decisions.what: No reverse-polarity/TVS part (Q7 stands)
decisions.why: like-for-like with the reference design; risk (reversed supply, hot-plug ring) written in COMPARISON.md

decisions.what: 10 uF PVCC decoupling in 0805 (Basic CL21A106KAYNNNE), not 1206
decisions.why: Basic part, smaller footprint helps size; 25 V rating kept

decisions.what: No switch-node EMI snubber (10R+330pF); keep only the 3.3R+10nF damping branch per channel output
decisions.why: like-for-like with the reference design and the EVM damping network; EMI not a stated requirement

decisions.what: Parts leads: TPA3118D2DAPR C46497; SLO0630H100MTT 10uH C207842 (Isat 5.5A); 680nF out filter; bulk MA25V100M6x6 polymer + RVT 100uF 35V electrolytic
decisions.why: P1 component-scout shortlist

decisions.what: P2 research tiers: class-d-amp + lc-output-filter researchers on fable/high (tier); dc-input + audio-line-in researchers and second readers on sonnet/high (explicit downgrade)
decisions.why: B1/B2 are low-risk textbook blocks already covered by P1 power.md/refdesign; owner asked for quality without burning money

decisions.what: Start P3 part-sourcer in parallel with P2 research, before H1
decisions.why: part choice doesn't turn on the checklist research; a value the research changes is amended in parts.json before P4

decisions.what: C11/C12 10 uF PVCC: accept X5R CL21A106KAYNNNE (C15850) though sheets.md said X7R
decisions.why: caps sit below 85 C (X5R limit) at <=1.5 W design dissipation; DC-bias loss at 12 V is covered by the 100 uF bulk per pair; Basic part

decisions.what: R4-R7 3.3R 0603 100 mW (RC0603FR-073R3L) accepted
decisions.why: branch dissipation ~1 mW: 10 nF is ~800 ohm at 20 kHz and ~40 ohm at 400 kHz against <0.3 V residual ripple

decisions.what: R4-R7+C23-C26 (3.3R+10nF) stay on the speaker side of the LC filter as TI's EMI C-RC snubber, not at the switch node
decisions.why: research: TI labels it an EMI snubber (corner ~4.8 MHz), not audio damping; at the switch node 10 nF x 12 V^2 x 400 kHz = 0.58 W would overload a 0603. Filter Q 0.52-1.04 over 4-8 ohm is acceptable per SLAA701B

decisions.what: designing under coverage gap: block:B1 dc-input classes power-loop, esd, sourcing, constraints-emission have no record at the approved floor; no second research round
decisions.why: B1 is two wire pads + two 100uF bulk caps with no protection by decision Q7; its loop/placement rules come from the verified B3 PVCC three-tier decoupling and dc-input hot-plug records; a 2nd round would cost ~$5-8 for little design delta

decisions.what: no TI Fig 37 PVCC RC damper (C58 100nF + R10 3.3R) added
decisions.why: C14 electrolytic ESR is the bulk damping per the verified dc-input-bulk-esr-damping-budget record; hot-plug ring margin 1.15x stays a P4-review watch item with RC snubber as fallback

decisions.what: U1 footprint fix: the 9 EasyEDA thermal vias (0.3 drill, 0.61 pad, 1.0 pitch 3x3) had empty pad numbers (no net -> 9 mask-bridge + 9 clearance errors); renumbered to pad 33 (GND) and set layers *.Cu only (no paste/mask on the vias: bottom tented, top inside the EP mask window)
decisions.why: thermal vias must be GND and join the bottom pour; record class-d-amp-powerpad-thermal-via-array asks component-side capping, which is impossible inside the EP window without plugging - via-in-pad plugging is the P9 alternative; 3x3 at 1.0 mm meets the >=6 count / <=1.2 mm pitch rule

decisions.what: wire-pad footprints: moved pin-1 silk corner 0.35 mm outside pad 1 (was over copper, 4 silk_over_copper warnings)
decisions.why: footprint-internal silk is a librarian fix; board_init self-check now 0 violations

decisions.what: review W1/W2: swap C13 to a >=35 V low-ESR polymer/hybrid D6.3 part and C14 to a 35 V part with a stated ESR/ripple; ADD a unidirectional TVS (SMBJ15A-class, clamp < 30 V abs max) across J1 +12V/GND
decisions.why: reviewer: 26 V hot-plug ring exceeds C13's 25 V and C14's ESR cannot damp the bank; TVS bounds the ring below U1's 30 V abs max. Correctness over the reference design's part count (deviation for COMPARISON)

decisions.what: review W3: C1-C4 2.2 uF -> 1 uF X7R 50 V 0805, K tolerance (TI Fig 37 value; corner 2.7 Hz at 60k)
decisions.why: 2.2 uF x 60k (132 ms) with no source connected reaches the 420 ms DC-detect window at tolerance corners and fault-cycles on power-up; deviation from the reference design's 2.2 uF recorded

decisions.what: review W4: reverse polarity stays unprotected (Q7) but J1 gets a +12V/GND silk legend; W5: C11/C12 X5R 10 uF accepted
decisions.why: W4 accepted risk, legend is free; W5: ~4-5 uF effective at 12 V is ample beside 200 uF bulk + 100 nF/1 nF HF caps

decisions.what: Schematic review W1-W3 fixed: C13 35V polymer C46550467, C14 FZ 35V C2992596 (stated ESR/ripple), C1-C4 1uF X7R C28323, D1 SMBJ15A C113988 across J1
decisions.why: W1 26V ring > 25V C13 and C14 cannot damp it -> TVS clamps; W2 RVT had no ESR spec; W3 132ms input tau vs 420ms DC-detect -> 60ms

decisions.what: Accept 53.6 x 36.8 mm outline (2 layers) as a deviation from the 44 x 34 target
decisions.why: Thermal/decoupling layout first: 25x25 mm clear thermal copper around U1, PVCC stacks at the pins, 7.3 mm inductors need 9.6 mm column pitch and 3x6 mm speaker wire pads J3/J4 take their own column; closing ~9 mm would need smaller inductors or wire pads, trading current rating/solderability for size

decisions.what: Strip body-outline silk from C0402/C0603/C0805/R0603 (lib + board) and widen IND courtyard to cover pads
decisions.why: 98 outline-vs-outline silk_overlap warnings in the dense PVCC/bootstrap stacks would fail drc_routed; passives are unpolarised, refdes kept; IND courtyard was smaller than its pads

decisions.what: P7->P6: spread L3/L4 up and L1/L2 down ~2.5 mm (grow outline height if needed) to fit the C15-C18 bootstrap caps in two columns and route OUT nets on F.Cu
decisions.why: OUT nets unroutable with current placement; caps-on-B.Cu alternative would cut the U1 heat-spreader pour edge with 8 vias; thermal first, area already a stated deviation
